        if ($target.hasClass('e-n-tab-content') && $target.hasClass('e-active')) {
          const $widget = $target.closest('.e-n-tabs, .elementor-widget-n-tabs');
          const $activeButton = $widget.find('.e-n-tab-title[aria-selected="true"]');
          const tabIndex = parseInt($activeButton.attr('data-tab-index'));
          setTimeout(function () { refreshSyncInContent($target, tabIndex); }, 100);
        }
      }
      if (mutation.type === 'attributes' && mutation.attributeName === 'aria-selected') {
        const $t = $(mutation.target);
        if ($t.hasClass('e-n-tab-title') && $t.attr('aria-selected') === 'true') {
          const contentId = $t.attr('aria-controls');
          const tabIndex = parseInt($t.attr('data-tab-index'));
          if (contentId) {
            setTimeout(function () {
              const $content = $('#' + contentId);
              if ($content.length) refreshSyncInContent($content, tabIndex);
            }, 100);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  });

  function observeNestedTabs() {
    const nestedTabWidgets = document.querySelectorAll('.e-n-tabs, .elementor-widget-n-tabs, .elementor-tabs');
    nestedTabWidgets.forEach(function (widget) {
      nestedTabsObserver.observe(widget, {
        attributes: true,
        attributeFilter: ['class', 'aria-selected'],
        subtree: true
      });
    });
  }

  if (window.elementorFrontend && elementorFrontend.hooks) {
    elementorFrontend.hooks.addAction('frontend/element_ready/nested-tabs.default', function (scope) {
      initServicesSync(scope);
      observeNestedTabs();
      setTimeout(function () {
        const $activeButton = scope.find('.e-n-tab-title[aria-selected="true"]');
        const tabIndex = parseInt($activeButton.attr('data-tab-index'));
        const $activeContent = scope.find('.e-n-tab-content.e-active, .elementor-tab-content.active');
        if ($activeContent.length) refreshSyncInContent($activeContent, tabIndex);
      }, 200);
    });

    elementorFrontend.hooks.addAction('frontend/element_ready/global', function (scope) {
      initServicesSync(scope);
    });
  }

  // ---------- initial attempts ----------
  $(document).ready(function () {
    setTimeout(function () {
      initServicesSync();
      observeNestedTabs();
      $(CAROUSEL_WRAPPER + ':visible').each(function () {
        const api = $(this).data('servicesSync');
        if (api && api.refresh) api.refresh();
      });
    }, 300);
  });

  $(window).on('load', function () {
    setTimeout(function () {
      observeNestedTabs();
      $(CAROUSEL_WRAPPER).each(function () {
        if ($(this).is(':visible')) {
          const api = $(this).data('servicesSync');
          if (api && api.refresh) api.refresh();
          else tryInitForWrap($(this));
        } else {
          attachInitOnActivation($(this));
        }
      });
    }, 500);
  });

  // Public API
  window.__servicesSyncRefresh = function (selector) {
    const $sel = selector ? $(selector) : $(document);
    initServicesSync($sel);
    observeNestedTabs();
    $sel.find(CAROUSEL_WRAPPER).each(function () {
      const api = $(this).data('servicesSync');
      if (api && api.refresh) api.refresh();
      else tryInitForWrap($(this));
    });
  };
});
</script>

          <textarea class="wgb__textarea" id="wgbDetail" name="detail"
                    placeholder="e.g. Replace two exterior light fixtures and repair a section of fence."></textarea>
          <p class="wgb__err" data-err="detail">Please add a short description.</p>

          <label class="wgb__label" for="wgbTiming">How soon? <span class="req">*</span></label>

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  /* Injected from brand.config.json by templatize.js */
  var WG_BOOKING = {{{BOOKING_JSON}}};

  var overlay = document.getElementById('wgbOverlay');
  if (!overlay) return;

  var form   = document.getElementById('wgbForm'),
      bar    = document.getElementById('wgbBar'),
      stepNo = document.getElementById('wgbStepNo'),
      back   = document.getElementById('wgbBack'),
      next   = document.getElementById('wgbNext'),
      steps  = [].slice.call(form.querySelectorAll('.wgb__step')),
      LAST   = steps.length,          // final step is the confirmation
      step   = 1,
      lastFocus = null;

  /* ---------- populate from config ---------- */
  document.getElementById('wgbServices').innerHTML =
    WG_BOOKING.services.concat(['Something else']).map(function (s, i) {
      return '<label class="wgb__opt"><input type="radio" name="service" value="' + s.replace(/"/g, '"') + '"' +
             (i === 0 ? '' : '') + '><span class="wgb__dot"></span><span>' + s + '</span></label>';
    }).join('');

  document.getElementById('wgbCity').innerHTML =
    '<option value="">Select your city…</option>' +
    WG_BOOKING.cities.map(function (c) { return '<option>' + c + '</option>'; }).join('') +
    '<option value="__other">Another city</option>';

  document.getElementById('wgbDoneMsg').textContent = WG_BOOKING.successMessage;

  var citySel  = document.getElementById('wgbCity'),
      otherWrap = document.getElementById('wgbOtherWrap');
  citySel.addEventListener('change', function () {
    otherWrap.style.display = citySel.value === '__other' ? 'block' : 'none';
  });

  /* ---------- validation ---------- */
  function showErr(key, on) {
    var el = form.querySelector('[data-err="' + key + '"]');
    if (el) el.classList.toggle('is-shown', !!on);
  }
  function mark(el, bad) { if (el) el.setAttribute('aria-invalid', bad ? 'true' : 'false'); }

  var RULES = {
    1: function () {
      var ok = !!form.querySelector('input[name="service"]:checked');
      showErr('service', !ok); return ok;
    },
    2: function () {
      var d = document.getElementById('wgbDetail'), t = document.getElementById('wgbTiming');
      var dOk = d.value.trim().length >= 5, tOk = !!t.value;
      showErr('detail', !dOk); mark(d, !dOk);
      showErr('timing', !tOk); mark(t, !tOk);
      return dOk && tOk;
    },
    3: function () {
      var ok = !!citySel.value; showErr('city', !ok); mark(citySel, !ok);
      if (citySel.value === '__other') {
        var o = document.getElementById('wgbOther'), oOk = o.value.trim().length > 1;
        showErr('cityOther', !oOk); mark(o, !oOk); ok = ok && oOk;
      }
      return ok;
    },
    4: function () {
      var n = document.getElementById('wgbName'),
          p = document.getElementById('wgbPhone'),
          e = document.getElementById('wgbEmail');
      var nOk = n.value.trim().length > 1,
          pOk = (p.value.match(/\d/g) || []).length >= 10,
          eOk = /^[^@\s]+@[^@\s.]+\.[^@\s]+$/.test(e.value.trim());
      showErr('name', !nOk);  mark(n, !nOk);
      showErr('phone', !pOk); mark(p, !pOk);
      showErr('email', !eOk); mark(e, !eOk);
      return nOk && pOk && eOk;
    }
  };

  /* ---------- navigation ---------- */
  function render() {
    steps.forEach(function (s) { s.classList.toggle('is-active', +s.dataset.step === step); });
    var done = step === LAST;
    bar.style.width = Math.round((Math.min(step, LAST - 1) / (LAST - 1)) * 100) + '%';
    stepNo.textContent = done ? 'Complete' : 'Step ' + step + ' of ' + (LAST - 1);
    back.style.visibility = (step === 1 || done) ? 'hidden' : 'visible';
    next.textContent = done ? 'Close' : (step === LAST - 1 ? 'Submit request' : 'Continue');
    var f = steps[step - 1].querySelector('input,select,textarea');
    if (f && !done) try { f.focus({ preventScroll: true }); } catch (e) {}
  }

  function submit() {
    var data = {};
    new FormData(form).forEach(function (v, k) { data[k] = v; });
    if (data.city === '__other') data.city = data.cityOther || '';

    document.getElementById('wgbRecap').innerHTML =
      '<div><b>Service:</b> ' + (data.service || '—') + '</div>' +
      '<div><b>Timeframe:</b> ' + (data.timing || '—') + '</div>' +
      '<div><b>City:</b> ' + (data.city || '—') + '</div>' +
      '<div><b>Contact:</b> ' + (data.name || '') + ' · ' + (data.phone || '') + '</div>';

    // No endpoint configured -> keep it locally so the flow is testable offline.
    try {
      var log = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('wgb_submissions') || '[]');
      log.push(Object.assign({ at: new Date().toISOString() }, data));
      localStorage.setItem('wgb_submissions', JSON.stringify(log));
    } catch (e) {}

    if (WG_BOOKING.endpoint) {
      next.disabled = true;
      // the intake workflow routes on _type === 'form'; anything else is
      // logged as a generic event and never reaches the leads table
      var payload = Object.assign({
        // the Route node reads `type` (or event_type) — NOT `_type`. Sending
        // _type alone falls through to 'event' and the lead is logged as a
        // generic event instead of reaching the leads table.
        type: 'form',
        form_type: 'estimate_request',
        source: 'handyman-demo',
        business_name: WG_BOOKING.business || '',
        business_id: WG_BOOKING.businessId || '',
        slug: WG_BOOKING.slug || '',
        page_url: location.href,
        created_at: new Date().toISOString()
      }, data);
      fetch(WG_BOOKING.endpoint, {
        method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload)
      }).catch(function () { /* already stored locally */ })
        .finally(function () { next.disabled = false; step = LAST; render(); });
      return;
    }
    step = LAST; render();
  }

  next.addEventListener('click', function () {
    if (step === LAST) return close();
    if (RULES[step] && !RULES[step]()) return;
    if (step === LAST - 1) return submit();
    step++; render();
  });
  back.addEventListener('click', function () { if (step > 1) { step--; render(); } });

  form.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && e.target.tagName !== 'TEXTAREA') { e.preventDefault(); next.click(); }
  });

  /* ---------- open / close ---------- */
  function open() {
    lastFocus = document.activeElement;
    overlay.hidden = false;
    requestAnimationFrame(function () { overlay.classList.add('is-open'); });
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    step = 1; form.reset(); otherWrap.style.display = 'none';
    form.querySelectorAll('.wgb__err').forEach(function (e) { e.classList.remove('is-shown'); });
    render();
  }
  function close() {
    overlay.classList.remove('is-open');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
    setTimeout(function () { overlay.hidden = true; }, 220);
    if (lastFocus) try { lastFocus.focus(); } catch (e) {}
  }
  window.wgbOpen = open;

  document.getElementById('wgbClose').addEventListener('click', close);
  overlay.addEventListener('mousedown', function (e) { if (e.target === overlay) close(); });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && !overlay.hidden) close();
    if (e.key === 'Tab' && !overlay.hidden) trap(e);
  });

  function trap(e) {
    var f = overlay.querySelectorAll('button,input,select,textarea,[href]');
    var vis = [].filter.call(f, function (el) { return el.offsetParent !== null && !el.disabled; });
    if (!vis.length) return;
    var first = vis[0], last = vis[vis.length - 1];
    if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) { e.preventDefault(); last.focus(); }
    else if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) { e.preventDefault(); first.focus(); }
  }

  /* ---------- wire every estimate CTA ---------- */
  function isEstimateCta(el) {
    var t = (el.textContent || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    return /free estimate|get a quote|book now|request estimate/.test(t);
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('a,button').forEach(function (el) {
    if (!isEstimateCta(el)) return;
    el.addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); open(); });
    if (el.tagName === 'A') el.setAttribute('role', 'button');

      <article class="pg-detail__i">
        <h3>Plumbing Fixtures</h3>

        <h3>Minor Drain Problems</h3>

      <article class="pg-detail__i">
        <h3>Garbage Disposals</h3>

      <article class="pg-detail__i">
        <h3>Dishwashers</h3>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    
    // Run only on screen widths greater than 767px
//     if (window.innerWidth <= 767) {
//         return; // Stop script for mobile
//     }

    // Function to show specific map and hide others
    function showMap(mapIndex) {
        const mapsContainer = document.querySelector('.service-area-maps');
        if (!mapsContainer) return;
        
        const allMaps = mapsContainer.children;
        
        // Hide all maps
        for (let i = 0; i < allMaps.length; i++) {
            allMaps[i].style.display = 'none';
        }
        
        // Show the selected map
        const targetMap = document.getElementById('map' + mapIndex);
        if (targetMap) {
            targetMap.style.display = 'block';
        }
    }
    
    // Initialize - show map1 by default
    showMap(1);
    
    // Get all accordion items
    const serviceAreaSection = document.querySelector('.service-area .locations');
    if (!serviceAreaSection) return;
    
    const accordionItems = serviceAreaSection.querySelectorAll('[data-accordion-index]');
    
    // Add click listeners
    accordionItems.forEach(function(accordionItem) {
        accordionItem.addEventListener('click', function() {
            const accordionIndex = this.getAttribute('data-accordion-index');
            if (accordionIndex) {
                showMap(parseInt(accordionIndex));
            }
        });
    });
});
</script>

        if ($target.hasClass('e-n-tab-content') && $target.hasClass('e-active')) {
          const $widget = $target.closest('.e-n-tabs, .elementor-widget-n-tabs');
          const $activeButton = $widget.find('.e-n-tab-title[aria-selected="true"]');
          const tabIndex = parseInt($activeButton.attr('data-tab-index'));
          setTimeout(function () { refreshSyncInContent($target, tabIndex); }, 100);
        }
      }
      if (mutation.type === 'attributes' && mutation.attributeName === 'aria-selected') {
        const $t = $(mutation.target);
        if ($t.hasClass('e-n-tab-title') && $t.attr('aria-selected') === 'true') {
          const contentId = $t.attr('aria-controls');
          const tabIndex = parseInt($t.attr('data-tab-index'));
          if (contentId) {
            setTimeout(function () {
              const $content = $('#' + contentId);
              if ($content.length) refreshSyncInContent($content, tabIndex);
            }, 100);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  });

  function observeNestedTabs() {
    const nestedTabWidgets = document.querySelectorAll('.e-n-tabs, .elementor-widget-n-tabs, .elementor-tabs');
    nestedTabWidgets.forEach(function (widget) {
      nestedTabsObserver.observe(widget, {
        attributes: true,
        attributeFilter: ['class', 'aria-selected'],
        subtree: true
      });
    });
  }

  if (window.elementorFrontend && elementorFrontend.hooks) {
    elementorFrontend.hooks.addAction('frontend/element_ready/nested-tabs.default', function (scope) {
      initServicesSync(scope);
      observeNestedTabs();
      setTimeout(function () {
        const $activeButton = scope.find('.e-n-tab-title[aria-selected="true"]');
        const tabIndex = parseInt($activeButton.attr('data-tab-index'));
        const $activeContent = scope.find('.e-n-tab-content.e-active, .elementor-tab-content.active');
        if ($activeContent.length) refreshSyncInContent($activeContent, tabIndex);
      }, 200);
    });

    elementorFrontend.hooks.addAction('frontend/element_ready/global', function (scope) {
      initServicesSync(scope);
    });
  }

  // ---------- initial attempts ----------
  $(document).ready(function () {
    setTimeout(function () {
      initServicesSync();
      observeNestedTabs();
      $(CAROUSEL_WRAPPER + ':visible').each(function () {
        const api = $(this).data('servicesSync');
        if (api && api.refresh) api.refresh();
      });
    }, 300);
  });

  $(window).on('load', function () {
    setTimeout(function () {
      observeNestedTabs();
      $(CAROUSEL_WRAPPER).each(function () {
        if ($(this).is(':visible')) {
          const api = $(this).data('servicesSync');
          if (api && api.refresh) api.refresh();
          else tryInitForWrap($(this));
        } else {
          attachInitOnActivation($(this));
        }
      });
    }, 500);
  });

  // Public API
  window.__servicesSyncRefresh = function (selector) {
    const $sel = selector ? $(selector) : $(document);
    initServicesSync($sel);
    observeNestedTabs();
    $sel.find(CAROUSEL_WRAPPER).each(function () {
      const api = $(this).data('servicesSync');
      if (api && api.refresh) api.refresh();
      else tryInitForWrap($(this));
    });
  };
});
</script>

          <textarea class="wgb__textarea" id="wgbDetail" name="detail"
                    placeholder="e.g. Replace two exterior light fixtures and repair a section of fence."></textarea>
          <p class="wgb__err" data-err="detail">Please add a short description.</p>

          <label class="wgb__label" for="wgbTiming">How soon? <span class="req">*</span></label>

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  /* Injected from brand.config.json by templatize.js */
  var WG_BOOKING = {{{BOOKING_JSON}}};

  var overlay = document.getElementById('wgbOverlay');
  if (!overlay) return;

  var form   = document.getElementById('wgbForm'),
      bar    = document.getElementById('wgbBar'),
      stepNo = document.getElementById('wgbStepNo'),
      back   = document.getElementById('wgbBack'),
      next   = document.getElementById('wgbNext'),
      steps  = [].slice.call(form.querySelectorAll('.wgb__step')),
      LAST   = steps.length,          // final step is the confirmation
      step   = 1,
      lastFocus = null;

  /* ---------- populate from config ---------- */
  document.getElementById('wgbServices').innerHTML =
    WG_BOOKING.services.concat(['Something else']).map(function (s, i) {
      return '<label class="wgb__opt"><input type="radio" name="service" value="' + s.replace(/"/g, '"') + '"' +
             (i === 0 ? '' : '') + '><span class="wgb__dot"></span><span>' + s + '</span></label>';
    }).join('');

  document.getElementById('wgbCity').innerHTML =
    '<option value="">Select your city…</option>' +
    WG_BOOKING.cities.map(function (c) { return '<option>' + c + '</option>'; }).join('') +
    '<option value="__other">Another city</option>';

  document.getElementById('wgbDoneMsg').textContent = WG_BOOKING.successMessage;

  var citySel  = document.getElementById('wgbCity'),
      otherWrap = document.getElementById('wgbOtherWrap');
  citySel.addEventListener('change', function () {
    otherWrap.style.display = citySel.value === '__other' ? 'block' : 'none';
  });

  /* ---------- validation ---------- */
  function showErr(key, on) {
    var el = form.querySelector('[data-err="' + key + '"]');
    if (el) el.classList.toggle('is-shown', !!on);
  }
  function mark(el, bad) { if (el) el.setAttribute('aria-invalid', bad ? 'true' : 'false'); }

  var RULES = {
    1: function () {
      var ok = !!form.querySelector('input[name="service"]:checked');
      showErr('service', !ok); return ok;
    },
    2: function () {
      var d = document.getElementById('wgbDetail'), t = document.getElementById('wgbTiming');
      var dOk = d.value.trim().length >= 5, tOk = !!t.value;
      showErr('detail', !dOk); mark(d, !dOk);
      showErr('timing', !tOk); mark(t, !tOk);
      return dOk && tOk;
    },
    3: function () {
      var ok = !!citySel.value; showErr('city', !ok); mark(citySel, !ok);
      if (citySel.value === '__other') {
        var o = document.getElementById('wgbOther'), oOk = o.value.trim().length > 1;
        showErr('cityOther', !oOk); mark(o, !oOk); ok = ok && oOk;
      }
      return ok;
    },
    4: function () {
      var n = document.getElementById('wgbName'),
          p = document.getElementById('wgbPhone'),
          e = document.getElementById('wgbEmail');
      var nOk = n.value.trim().length > 1,
          pOk = (p.value.match(/\d/g) || []).length >= 10,
          eOk = /^[^@\s]+@[^@\s.]+\.[^@\s]+$/.test(e.value.trim());
      showErr('name', !nOk);  mark(n, !nOk);
      showErr('phone', !pOk); mark(p, !pOk);
      showErr('email', !eOk); mark(e, !eOk);
      return nOk && pOk && eOk;
    }
  };

  /* ---------- navigation ---------- */
  function render() {
    steps.forEach(function (s) { s.classList.toggle('is-active', +s.dataset.step === step); });
    var done = step === LAST;
    bar.style.width = Math.round((Math.min(step, LAST - 1) / (LAST - 1)) * 100) + '%';
    stepNo.textContent = done ? 'Complete' : 'Step ' + step + ' of ' + (LAST - 1);
    back.style.visibility = (step === 1 || done) ? 'hidden' : 'visible';
    next.textContent = done ? 'Close' : (step === LAST - 1 ? 'Submit request' : 'Continue');
    var f = steps[step - 1].querySelector('input,select,textarea');
    if (f && !done) try { f.focus({ preventScroll: true }); } catch (e) {}
  }

  function submit() {
    var data = {};
    new FormData(form).forEach(function (v, k) { data[k] = v; });
    if (data.city === '__other') data.city = data.cityOther || '';

    document.getElementById('wgbRecap').innerHTML =
      '<div><b>Service:</b> ' + (data.service || '—') + '</div>' +
      '<div><b>Timeframe:</b> ' + (data.timing || '—') + '</div>' +
      '<div><b>City:</b> ' + (data.city || '—') + '</div>' +
      '<div><b>Contact:</b> ' + (data.name || '') + ' · ' + (data.phone || '') + '</div>';

    // No endpoint configured -> keep it locally so the flow is testable offline.
    try {
      var log = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('wgb_submissions') || '[]');
      log.push(Object.assign({ at: new Date().toISOString() }, data));
      localStorage.setItem('wgb_submissions', JSON.stringify(log));
    } catch (e) {}

    if (WG_BOOKING.endpoint) {
      next.disabled = true;
      // the intake workflow routes on _type === 'form'; anything else is
      // logged as a generic event and never reaches the leads table
      var payload = Object.assign({
        // the Route node reads `type` (or event_type) — NOT `_type`. Sending
        // _type alone falls through to 'event' and the lead is logged as a
        // generic event instead of reaching the leads table.
        type: 'form',
        form_type: 'estimate_request',
        source: 'handyman-demo',
        business_name: WG_BOOKING.business || '',
        business_id: WG_BOOKING.businessId || '',
        slug: WG_BOOKING.slug || '',
        page_url: location.href,
        created_at: new Date().toISOString()
      }, data);
      fetch(WG_BOOKING.endpoint, {
        method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload)
      }).catch(function () { /* already stored locally */ })
        .finally(function () { next.disabled = false; step = LAST; render(); });
      return;
    }
    step = LAST; render();
  }

  next.addEventListener('click', function () {
    if (step === LAST) return close();
    if (RULES[step] && !RULES[step]()) return;
    if (step === LAST - 1) return submit();
    step++; render();
  });
  back.addEventListener('click', function () { if (step > 1) { step--; render(); } });

  form.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && e.target.tagName !== 'TEXTAREA') { e.preventDefault(); next.click(); }
  });

  /* ---------- open / close ---------- */
  function open() {
    lastFocus = document.activeElement;
    overlay.hidden = false;
    requestAnimationFrame(function () { overlay.classList.add('is-open'); });
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    step = 1; form.reset(); otherWrap.style.display = 'none';
    form.querySelectorAll('.wgb__err').forEach(function (e) { e.classList.remove('is-shown'); });
    render();
  }
  function close() {
    overlay.classList.remove('is-open');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
    setTimeout(function () { overlay.hidden = true; }, 220);
    if (lastFocus) try { lastFocus.focus(); } catch (e) {}
  }
  window.wgbOpen = open;

  document.getElementById('wgbClose').addEventListener('click', close);
  overlay.addEventListener('mousedown', function (e) { if (e.target === overlay) close(); });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && !overlay.hidden) close();
    if (e.key === 'Tab' && !overlay.hidden) trap(e);
  });

  function trap(e) {
    var f = overlay.querySelectorAll('button,input,select,textarea,[href]');
    var vis = [].filter.call(f, function (el) { return el.offsetParent !== null && !el.disabled; });
    if (!vis.length) return;
    var first = vis[0], last = vis[vis.length - 1];
    if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) { e.preventDefault(); last.focus(); }
    else if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) { e.preventDefault(); first.focus(); }
  }

  /* ---------- wire every estimate CTA ---------- */
  function isEstimateCta(el) {
    var t = (el.textContent || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    return /free estimate|get a quote|book now|request estimate/.test(t);
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('a,button').forEach(function (el) {
    if (!isEstimateCta(el)) return;
    el.addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); open(); });
    if (el.tagName === 'A') el.setAttribute('role', 'button');

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    
    // Run only on screen widths greater than 767px
//     if (window.innerWidth <= 767) {
//         return; // Stop script for mobile
//     }

    // Function to show specific map and hide others
    function showMap(mapIndex) {
        const mapsContainer = document.querySelector('.service-area-maps');
        if (!mapsContainer) return;
        
        const allMaps = mapsContainer.children;
        
        // Hide all maps
        for (let i = 0; i < allMaps.length; i++) {
            allMaps[i].style.display = 'none';
        }
        
        // Show the selected map
        const targetMap = document.getElementById('map' + mapIndex);
        if (targetMap) {
            targetMap.style.display = 'block';
        }
    }
    
    // Initialize - show map1 by default
    showMap(1);
    
    // Get all accordion items
    const serviceAreaSection = document.querySelector('.service-area .locations');
    if (!serviceAreaSection) return;
    
    const accordionItems = serviceAreaSection.querySelectorAll('[data-accordion-index]');
    
    // Add click listeners
    accordionItems.forEach(function(accordionItem) {
        accordionItem.addEventListener('click', function() {
            const accordionIndex = this.getAttribute('data-accordion-index');
            if (accordionIndex) {
                showMap(parseInt(accordionIndex));
            }
        });
    });
});
</script>

      if (mutation.type === 'attributes' && mutation.attributeName === 'aria-selected') {
        const $t = $(mutation.target);
        if ($t.hasClass('e-n-tab-title') && $t.attr('aria-selected') === 'true') {
          const contentId = $t.attr('aria-controls');
          const tabIndex = parseInt($t.attr('data-tab-index'));
          if (contentId) {
            setTimeout(function () {
              const $content = $('#' + contentId);
              if ($content.length) refreshSyncInContent($content, tabIndex);
            }, 100);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  });

  function observeNestedTabs() {
    const nestedTabWidgets = document.querySelectorAll('.e-n-tabs, .elementor-widget-n-tabs, .elementor-tabs');
    nestedTabWidgets.forEach(function (widget) {
      nestedTabsObserver.observe(widget, {
        attributes: true,
        attributeFilter: ['class', 'aria-selected'],
        subtree: true
      });
    });
  }

  if (window.elementorFrontend && elementorFrontend.hooks) {
    elementorFrontend.hooks.addAction('frontend/element_ready/nested-tabs.default', function (scope) {
      initServicesSync(scope);
      observeNestedTabs();
      setTimeout(function () {
        const $activeButton = scope.find('.e-n-tab-title[aria-selected="true"]');
        const tabIndex = parseInt($activeButton.attr('data-tab-index'));
        const $activeContent = scope.find('.e-n-tab-content.e-active, .elementor-tab-content.active');
        if ($activeContent.length) refreshSyncInContent($activeContent, tabIndex);
      }, 200);
    });

    elementorFrontend.hooks.addAction('frontend/element_ready/global', function (scope) {
      initServicesSync(scope);
    });
  }

  // ---------- initial attempts ----------
  $(document).ready(function () {
    setTimeout(function () {
      initServicesSync();
      observeNestedTabs();
      $(CAROUSEL_WRAPPER + ':visible').each(function () {
        const api = $(this).data('servicesSync');
        if (api && api.refresh) api.refresh();
      });
    }, 300);
  });

  $(window).on('load', function () {
    setTimeout(function () {
      observeNestedTabs();
      $(CAROUSEL_WRAPPER).each(function () {
        if ($(this).is(':visible')) {
          const api = $(this).data('servicesSync');
          if (api && api.refresh) api.refresh();
          else tryInitForWrap($(this));
        } else {
          attachInitOnActivation($(this));
        }
      });
    }, 500);
  });

  // Public API
  window.__servicesSyncRefresh = function (selector) {
    const $sel = selector ? $(selector) : $(document);
    initServicesSync($sel);
    observeNestedTabs();
    $sel.find(CAROUSEL_WRAPPER).each(function () {
      const api = $(this).data('servicesSync');
      if (api && api.refresh) api.refresh();
      else tryInitForWrap($(this));
    });
  };
});
</script>



<!-- ===================================================================

<style>

@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .wgb-overlay,.wgb,.wgb__bar span{transition:none}

<div class="wgb-overlay" id="wgbOverlay" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="wgbTitle" hidden>
  <div class="wgb" role="document">
    <div class="wgb__head">
      <h2 class="wgb__title" id="wgbTitle">Get a free estimate</h2>
      <p class="wgb__sub">A few quick questions and we'll follow up with your quote.</p>
      <div class="wgb__bar"><span id="wgbBar"></span></div>
      <span class="wgb__stepno" id="wgbStepNo">Step 1 of 4</span>
      <button type="button" class="wgb__close" id="wgbClose" aria-label="Close">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M18 6 6 18M6 6l12 12" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
      </button>
    </div>

    <form class="wgb__body" id="wgbForm" novalidate>
      <!-- 1 — service -->
      <section class="wgb__step is-active" data-step="1">
        <h3 class="wgb__q">What do you need help with?</h3>
        <div class="wgb__grid" id="wgbServices"></div>
        <p class="wgb__err" data-err="service">Please choose one to continue.</p>
      </section>

      <!-- 2 — detail + urgency -->
      <section class="wgb__step" data-step="2">
        <h3 class="wgb__q">Tell us about the project</h3>
        <div class="wgb__field">
          <label class="wgb__label" for="wgbDetail">Briefly, what needs doing? <span class="req">*</span></label>
          <textarea class="wgb__textarea" id="wgbDetail" name="detail"
                    placeholder="e.g. Replace two exterior light fixtures and repair a section of fence."></textarea>
          <p class="wgb__err" data-err="detail">Please add a short description.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="wgb__field">
          <label class="wgb__label" for="wgbTiming">How soon? <span class="req">*</span></label>
          <select class="wgb__select" id="wgbTiming" name="timing">
            <option value="">Select a timeframe…</option>
            <option>Emergency — as soon as possible</option>
            <option>Within a week</option>
            <option>Within 2–4 weeks</option>
            <option>Just planning ahead</option>
          </select>
          <p class="wgb__err" data-err="timing">Please pick a timeframe.</p>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- 3 — location -->
      <section class="wgb__step" data-step="3">
        <h3 class="wgb__q">Where is the property?</h3>
        <div class="wgb__field">
          <label class="wgb__label" for="wgbCity">City <span class="req">*</span></label>
          <select class="wgb__select" id="wgbCity" name="city"></select>
          <p class="wgb__err" data-err="city">Please select your city.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="wgb__field" id="wgbOtherWrap" style="display:none">
          <label class="wgb__label" for="wgbOther">Which city? <span class="req">*</span></label>
          <input class="wgb__input" id="wgbOther" name="cityOther" type="text" placeholder="City name">
          <p class="wgb__err" data-err="cityOther">Please tell us the city.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="wgb__field">
          <label class="wgb__label" for="wgbAddr">Street address <span style="font-weight:400;color:#69727d">(optional)</span></label>
          <input class="wgb__input" id="wgbAddr" name="address" type="text" autocomplete="street-address">
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- 4 — contact -->
      <section class="wgb__step" data-step="4">
        <h3 class="wgb__q">How should we reach you?</h3>
        <div class="wgb__field">
          <label class="wgb__label" for="wgbName">Full name <span class="req">*</span></label>
          <input class="wgb__input" id="wgbName" name="name" type="text" autocomplete="name">
          <p class="wgb__err" data-err="name">Please enter your name.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="wgb__field">
          <label class="wgb__label" for="wgbPhone">Phone <span class="req">*</span></label>
          <input class="wgb__input" id="wgbPhone" name="phone" type="tel" autocomplete="tel" inputmode="tel"
                 placeholder="(555) 010-0000">
          <p class="wgb__err" data-err="phone">Enter a phone number with at least 10 digits.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="wgb__field">
          <label class="wgb__label" for="wgbEmail">Email <span class="req">*</span></label>
          <input class="wgb__input" id="wgbEmail" name="email" type="email" autocomplete="email"
                 placeholder="you@example.com">
          <p class="wgb__err" data-err="email">Enter a valid email address.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="wgb__field">
          <label class="wgb__label" for="wgbWhen">Best time to call</label>
          <select class="wgb__select" id="wgbWhen" name="bestTime">
            <option>Anytime</option><option>Morning</option><option>Afternoon</option><option>Evening</option>
          </select>

      <!-- 5 — done -->

          <h3>Request received</h3>
          <p id="wgbDoneMsg">Thanks — we'll review the details and follow up shortly with your estimate.</p>

    </form>

    <div class="wgb__foot">
      <button type="button" class="wgb__btn wgb__btn--ghost" id="wgbBack">← Back</button>
      <button type="button" class="wgb__btn" id="wgbNext">Continue</button>
    </div>

</div>

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  /* Injected from brand.config.json by templatize.js */
  var WG_BOOKING = {{{BOOKING_JSON}}};

  var overlay = document.getElementById('wgbOverlay');
  if (!overlay) return;

  var form   = document.getElementById('wgbForm'),
      bar    = document.getElementById('wgbBar'),
      stepNo = document.getElementById('wgbStepNo'),
      back   = document.getElementById('wgbBack'),
      next   = document.getElementById('wgbNext'),
      steps  = [].slice.call(form.querySelectorAll('.wgb__step')),
      LAST   = steps.length,          // final step is the confirmation
      step   = 1,
      lastFocus = null;

  /* ---------- populate from config ---------- */
  document.getElementById('wgbServices').innerHTML =
    WG_BOOKING.services.concat(['Something else']).map(function (s, i) {
      return '<label class="wgb__opt"><input type="radio" name="service" value="' + s.replace(/"/g, '"') + '"' +
             (i === 0 ? '' : '') + '><span class="wgb__dot"></span><span>' + s + '</span></label>';
    }).join('');

  document.getElementById('wgbCity').innerHTML =
    '<option value="">Select your city…</option>' +
    WG_BOOKING.cities.map(function (c) { return '<option>' + c + '</option>'; }).join('') +
    '<option value="__other">Another city</option>';

  document.getElementById('wgbDoneMsg').textContent = WG_BOOKING.successMessage;

  var citySel  = document.getElementById('wgbCity'),
      otherWrap = document.getElementById('wgbOtherWrap');
  citySel.addEventListener('change', function () {
    otherWrap.style.display = citySel.value === '__other' ? 'block' : 'none';
  });

  /* ---------- validation ---------- */
  function showErr(key, on) {
    var el = form.querySelector('[data-err="' + key + '"]');
    if (el) el.classList.toggle('is-shown', !!on);
  }
  function mark(el, bad) { if (el) el.setAttribute('aria-invalid', bad ? 'true' : 'false'); }

  var RULES = {
    1: function () {
      var ok = !!form.querySelector('input[name="service"]:checked');
      showErr('service', !ok); return ok;
    },
    2: function () {
      var d = document.getElementById('wgbDetail'), t = document.getElementById('wgbTiming');
      var dOk = d.value.trim().length >= 5, tOk = !!t.value;
      showErr('detail', !dOk); mark(d, !dOk);
      showErr('timing', !tOk); mark(t, !tOk);
      return dOk && tOk;
    },
    3: function () {
      var ok = !!citySel.value; showErr('city', !ok); mark(citySel, !ok);
      if (citySel.value === '__other') {
        var o = document.getElementById('wgbOther'), oOk = o.value.trim().length > 1;
        showErr('cityOther', !oOk); mark(o, !oOk); ok = ok && oOk;
      }
      return ok;
    },
    4: function () {
      var n = document.getElementById('wgbName'),
          p = document.getElementById('wgbPhone'),
          e = document.getElementById('wgbEmail');
      var nOk = n.value.trim().length > 1,
          pOk = (p.value.match(/\d/g) || []).length >= 10,
          eOk = /^[^@\s]+@[^@\s.]+\.[^@\s]+$/.test(e.value.trim());
      showErr('name', !nOk);  mark(n, !nOk);
      showErr('phone', !pOk); mark(p, !pOk);
      showErr('email', !eOk); mark(e, !eOk);
      return nOk && pOk && eOk;
    }
  };

  /* ---------- navigation ---------- */
  function render() {
    steps.forEach(function (s) { s.classList.toggle('is-active', +s.dataset.step === step); });
    var done = step === LAST;
    bar.style.width = Math.round((Math.min(step, LAST - 1) / (LAST - 1)) * 100) + '%';
    stepNo.textContent = done ? 'Complete' : 'Step ' + step + ' of ' + (LAST - 1);
    back.style.visibility = (step === 1 || done) ? 'hidden' : 'visible';
    next.textContent = done ? 'Close' : (step === LAST - 1 ? 'Submit request' : 'Continue');
    var f = steps[step - 1].querySelector('input,select,textarea');
    if (f && !done) try { f.focus({ preventScroll: true }); } catch (e) {}
  }

  function submit() {
    var data = {};
    new FormData(form).forEach(function (v, k) { data[k] = v; });
    if (data.city === '__other') data.city = data.cityOther || '';

    document.getElementById('wgbRecap').innerHTML =
      '<div><b>Service:</b> ' + (data.service || '—') + '</div>' +
      '<div><b>Timeframe:</b> ' + (data.timing || '—') + '</div>' +
      '<div><b>City:</b> ' + (data.city || '—') + '</div>' +
      '<div><b>Contact:</b> ' + (data.name || '') + ' · ' + (data.phone || '') + '</div>';

    // No endpoint configured -> keep it locally so the flow is testable offline.
    try {
      var log = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('wgb_submissions') || '[]');
      log.push(Object.assign({ at: new Date().toISOString() }, data));
      localStorage.setItem('wgb_submissions', JSON.stringify(log));
    } catch (e) {}

    if (WG_BOOKING.endpoint) {
      next.disabled = true;
      // the intake workflow routes on _type === 'form'; anything else is
      // logged as a generic event and never reaches the leads table
      var payload = Object.assign({
        // the Route node reads `type` (or event_type) — NOT `_type`. Sending
        // _type alone falls through to 'event' and the lead is logged as a
        // generic event instead of reaching the leads table.
        type: 'form',
        form_type: 'estimate_request',
        source: 'handyman-demo',
        business_name: WG_BOOKING.business || '',
        business_id: WG_BOOKING.businessId || '',
        slug: WG_BOOKING.slug || '',
        page_url: location.href,
        created_at: new Date().toISOString()
      }, data);
      fetch(WG_BOOKING.endpoint, {
        method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload)
      }).catch(function () { /* already stored locally */ })
        .finally(function () { next.disabled = false; step = LAST; render(); });
      return;
    }
    step = LAST; render();
  }

  next.addEventListener('click', function () {
    if (step === LAST) return close();
    if (RULES[step] && !RULES[step]()) return;
    if (step === LAST - 1) return submit();
    step++; render();
  });
  back.addEventListener('click', function () { if (step > 1) { step--; render(); } });

  form.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && e.target.tagName !== 'TEXTAREA') { e.preventDefault(); next.click(); }
  });

  /* ---------- open / close ---------- */
  function open() {
    lastFocus = document.activeElement;
    overlay.hidden = false;
    requestAnimationFrame(function () { overlay.classList.add('is-open'); });
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    step = 1; form.reset(); otherWrap.style.display = 'none';
    form.querySelectorAll('.wgb__err').forEach(function (e) { e.classList.remove('is-shown'); });
    render();
  }
  function close() {
    overlay.classList.remove('is-open');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
    setTimeout(function () { overlay.hidden = true; }, 220);
    if (lastFocus) try { lastFocus.focus(); } catch (e) {}
  }
  window.wgbOpen = open;

  document.getElementById('wgbClose').addEventListener('click', close);
  overlay.addEventListener('mousedown', function (e) { if (e.target === overlay) close(); });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && !overlay.hidden) close();
    if (e.key === 'Tab' && !overlay.hidden) trap(e);
  });

  function trap(e) {
    var f = overlay.querySelectorAll('button,input,select,textarea,[href]');
    var vis = [].filter.call(f, function (el) { return el.offsetParent !== null && !el.disabled; });
    if (!vis.length) return;
    var first = vis[0], last = vis[vis.length - 1];
    if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) { e.preventDefault(); last.focus(); }
    else if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) { e.preventDefault(); first.focus(); }
  }

  /* ---------- wire every estimate CTA ---------- */
  function isEstimateCta(el) {
    var t = (el.textContent || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    return /free estimate|get a quote|book now|request estimate/.test(t);
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('a,button').forEach(function (el) {
    if (!isEstimateCta(el)) return;
    el.addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); open(); });
    if (el.tagName === 'A') el.setAttribute('role', 'button');
  });
})();
</script>

<script>
document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
  var a = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('a[href="#book"]');
  if (!a) return;
  e.preventDefault();
  if (typeof window.wgbOpen === 'function') window.wgbOpen();
});
</script>

    // Function to show specific map and hide others
    function showMap(mapIndex) {
        const mapsContainer = document.querySelector('.service-area-maps');
        if (!mapsContainer) return;
        
        const allMaps = mapsContainer.children;
        
        // Hide all maps
        for (let i = 0; i < allMaps.length; i++) {
            allMaps[i].style.display = 'none';
        }
        
        // Show the selected map

        if (targetMap) {
            targetMap.style.display = 'block';
        }
    }
    
    // Initialize - show map1 by default

    const serviceAreaSection = document.querySelector('.service-area .locations');
    if (!serviceAreaSection) return;
    
    const accordionItems = serviceAreaSection.querySelectorAll('[data-accordion-index]');
    
    // Add click listeners
    accordionItems.forEach(function(accordionItem) {
        accordionItem.addEventListener('click', function() {
            const accordionIndex = this.getAttribute('data-accordion-index');
            if (accordionIndex) {
                showMap(parseInt(accordionIndex));
            }
        });
    });
});

<script>

  function createServicesSync($wrap) {
    if (!$wrap.length) return null;
    if ($wrap.data('servicesSync')) return $wrap.data('servicesSync');

    const $swiperEl = $wrap.find('.swiper').first();
    if (!$swiperEl.length) return null;

      swiperInst.params.slideToClickedSlide = false;
    }

    let $slidesAll = $wrap.find('.swiper-slide');
    
    // CRITICAL: Find the parent tab content to scope intro boxes correctly
    const $parentTabContent = $wrap.closest('.e-n-tab-content, .elementor-tab-content, .tab-pane, .tab-content');
    console.log('Parent tab content found:', $parentTabContent.length, $parentTabContent.attr('id'));

    function setVisibleByRealIndex(realIdx) {
      console.log('setVisibleByRealIndex called with:', realIdx, 'in tab:', $parentTabContent.attr('id'));
      
      // CLEAR on ALL slides
      $wrap.find(SERVICE_BOX_SEL).removeClass('visible');
      
      // CRITICAL: Only target intro boxes WITHIN this tab content
      let $introsInThisTab;
      if ($parentTabContent.length) {
        $introsInThisTab = $parentTabContent.find('[id^="intro-"]');
        console.log('Found intro boxes in this tab:', $introsInThisTab.length);
      } else {
        // Fallback: find intros near the carousel
        $introsInThisTab = $wrap.closest('.elementor-section, .e-con, section').find('[id^="intro-"]');

      }
      
      // Clear visible from intros in THIS tab only
      $introsInThisTab.removeClass('visible');
      $introsInThisTab.each(function() {
        this.classList.remove('visible');
      });

      // ADD .visible to ALL slides with this realIdx
      const selector = '[data-swiper-slide-index="' + realIdx + '"]';
      const $targetSlides = $slidesAll.filter(selector);
      $targetSlides.find(SERVICE_BOX_SEL).addClass('visible');

      // Mark matching intro (1-based ids: #intro-1..#intro-5)
      const introId = 'intro-' + (realIdx + 1);
      console.log('Looking for intro:', introId, 'within tab');
      
      // Find the specific intro in THIS tab
      const $targetIntro = $introsInThisTab.filter('#' + introId);
      console.log('Found target intro:', $targetIntro.length, $targetIntro.attr('id'));
      
      if ($targetIntro.length) {
        $targetIntro.addClass('visible');
        $targetIntro[0].classList.add('visible');
        console.log('Added visible class to:', $targetIntro.attr('id'));

        console.warn('Could not find intro:', introId, 'in this tab');

      // Verify
      setTimeout(function() {
        const visibleInTab = $introsInThisTab.filter('.visible').map(function() { return this.id; }).get();
        console.log('Visible intros in this tab:', visibleInTab);
      }, 50);
    }

    // initial set
    setVisibleByRealIndex(swiperInst.realIndex);

    // bind slideChange
    swiperInst.off?.('slideChange.servicesSync');
    swiperInst.on('slideChange', function () {
      setVisibleByRealIndex(swiperInst.realIndex);
    });

    // click on service box
    $wrap.off('.servicesSync').on('click.servicesSync', SERVICE_BOX_SEL, function (e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (typeof e.stopImmediatePropagation === 'function') e.stopImmediatePropagation();

<script>
jQuery(function ($) {
  const CAROUSEL_WRAPPER = '.tab-services';
  const SERVICE_BOX_SEL  = '.select-card';
  const RETRY_DELAY = 250;
  const MAX_RETRIES = 12;

  // ----- helper: find nearest container that has intro-X elements -----
  function findNearestIntroContainer($start) {
    const $ancestors = $start.parents();
    for (let i = 0; i < $ancestors.length; i++) {
      const $a = $($ancestors[i]);
      if ($a.find('[id^="intro-"]').length) return $a;
    }
    return null;
  }

  function getSwiperInstanceFromEl($swiperEl) {
    try {
      const el = $swiperEl.get(0);
      if (!el) return null;
      return el.swiper || ($swiperEl.data && $swiperEl.data('swiper')) || null;
    } catch (e) { return null; }
  }

  // ---------- createServicesSync (with per-wrap intro mapping) ----------
  function createServicesSync($wrap) {
    if (!$wrap.length) return null;
    if ($wrap.data('servicesSync')) return $wrap.data('servicesSync');

    const $swiperEl = $wrap.find('.swiper').first();
    if (!$swiperEl.length) return null;

    const swiperInst = getSwiperInstanceFromEl($swiperEl);
    if (!swiperInst) return null;

    // disable slideToClickedSlide if present
    if (swiperInst.params && swiperInst.params.slideToClickedSlide) {
      swiperInst.params.slideToClickedSlide = false;
    }

    // Strictly scoped slides for this wrap
    let $slidesAll = $wrap.find('.swiper-slide');

    // Build a local map of intro elements for this wrap (index -> element)
    // We look for an intro container nearest to the wrap
    const introContainer = (function locate() {
      // prefer explicit container near wrap (select-content etc.)
      let $hint = $wrap.closest('.elementor-column, .elementor-widget, .elementor-section, .e-con, .select-content');
      if ($hint && $hint.length && $hint.find('[id^="intro-"]').length) return $hint;
      // next prefer nearest ancestor that contains intro-X
      const $nearest = findNearestIntroContainer($wrap);
      if ($nearest && $nearest.length) return $nearest;
      // fallback to searching siblings in the row/section
      const $sibling = $wrap.closest('.elementor-section, .elementor-column, .e-con').find('[id^="intro-"]');
      if ($sibling && $sibling.length) return $sibling.parent().first();
      // very last resort: empty jQuery set (we will not touch globals)
      return $();
    })();

    // Map: index (0-based) -> jQuery element(s) for that intro in this wrap
    const introMap = [];
    if (introContainer && introContainer.length) {
      const $localIntros = introContainer.find('[id^="intro-"]');
      $localIntros.each(function () {
        // id pattern intro-<n>
        const id = this.id || '';
        const parts = id.split('-');
        const n = Number(parts[1]) - 1; // convert to 0-based
        if (!Number.isNaN(n) && n >= 0) {
          introMap[n] = introMap[n] || $();
          introMap[n] = introMap[n].add(this);
        }
      });
    }

    // helper: get intro jQuery for a realIndex (may be undefined)
    function getIntroForIndex(idx) {
      return (introMap && introMap[idx]) ? introMap[idx] : $();
    }

    // helper: strictly find slides in this wrap that represent realIdx
    function findSlidesForRealIndex(realIdx) {
      const idx = Number(realIdx) || 0;
      // prefer data-swiper-slide-index within this wrap
      let $target = $slidesAll.filter('[data-swiper-slide-index="' + idx + '"]');

      // fallback: check data-slide or aria-label within slides inside this wrap
      if (!$target.length) {
        $target = $slidesAll.filter(function () {
          const ds = this.getAttribute && this.getAttribute('data-slide');
          if (typeof ds !== 'undefined' && Number(ds) - 1 === idx) return true;
          const al = this.getAttribute && this.getAttribute('aria-label');
          if (al && /^\d+\s*\/\s*\d+$/.test(al)) {
            const parts = al.split('/');
            const val = Number(parts[0]);
            return !Number.isNaN(val) && (val - 1) === idx;
          }
          return false;
        });
      }

      // final: use eq within wrap
      if (!$target.length) $target = $slidesAll.eq(idx);
      return $($target);
    }

    // Clear visible/ticker FROM THIS wrap only
    function clearThisWrap() {
      $wrap.find(SERVICE_BOX_SEL).removeClass('visible');
      $wrap.find(SERVICE_BOX_SEL).parent().removeClass('ticker');
      // Also remove intro visible states for this wrap only
      for (let i = 0; i < introMap.length; i++) {
        if (introMap[i] && introMap[i].length) introMap[i].removeClass('visible');
      }
    }

    // Defensive: clear other wraps' visible/ticker and their intros (so one click can't leave other wraps active)
    function clearOtherWraps() {
      $(CAROUSEL_WRAPPER).not($wrap).each(function () {
        const $other = $(this);
        $other.find(SERVICE_BOX_SEL).removeClass('visible');
        $other.find(SERVICE_BOX_SEL).parent().removeClass('ticker');

        // try to remove intro visible from nearest intro container of that other wrap
        const $ic = findNearestIntroContainer($other);
        if ($ic && $ic.length) $ic.find('[id^="intro-"]').removeClass('visible');
      });
    }

    // is wrap currently active (visible or its tab content active)
    function isWrapActive($w) {
      try {
        if ($w.is(':visible')) return true;
        const $tab = $w.closest('.e-n-tab-content, .elementor-tab-content, .tab-pane, .tab-content');
        if ($tab && $tab.length) {
          if ($tab.hasClass('e-active') || $tab.is(':visible') || $tab.attr('aria-hidden') === 'false') return true;
          const widget = $tab.closest('.e-n-tabs, .elementor-widget-n-tabs, .elementor-tabs');
          if (widget && widget.length) {
            const $activeTitle = widget.find('.e-n-tab-title[aria-selected="true"], .elementor-tab-title[aria-selected="true"]');
            if ($activeTitle && $activeTitle.length) return true;
          }
        }
        return false;
      } catch (e) { return false; }
    }

    // The main toggler — strictly scoped and uses the introMap
    function setVisibleByRealIndex(realIdx) {
      realIdx = Number(realIdx) || 0;

      // Only perform DOM toggles for active wraps
      if (!isWrapActive($wrap)) {
        console.log('servicesSync: skipping DOM toggle for inactive wrap index', $('.tab-services').index($wrap));
        return;
      }

      // Clear current wrap and other wraps (defensive)
      clearThisWrap();
      clearOtherWraps();

      const $targetSlides = findSlidesForRealIndex(realIdx);
      // strictly scoped service boxes (descendants of this wrap)
      let $serviceBoxes = $targetSlides.find(SERVICE_BOX_SEL).filter(function () {
        return $.contains($wrap.get(0), this);
      });

      // fallback: if none found, attempt to find slide inside wrap with matching data-swiper-slide-index
      if (!$serviceBoxes.length) {
        $serviceBoxes = $wrap.find('.swiper-slide[data-swiper-slide-index="' + realIdx + '"]').find(SERVICE_BOX_SEL);
      }

      $serviceBoxes.addClass('visible');
      $serviceBoxes.each(function () { $(this).parent().addClass('ticker'); });

      // Now show intro(s) that belong to this wrap only using introMap
      const $intro = getIntroForIndex(realIdx);
      if ($intro && $intro.length) {
        $intro.addClass('visible');
      }

      // Debug trace
      console.log('servicesSync: toggled wrap', $('.tab-services').index($wrap), 'realIdx', realIdx,
                  'slidesFound', $targetSlides.length, 'serviceBoxes', $serviceBoxes.length,
                  'introShown', ($intro && $intro.length) ? $intro.map(function(){return this.id;}).get() : []);
    }

    // Initial call only if wrap is active now
    if (isWrapActive($wrap)) {
      setVisibleByRealIndex(swiperInst.realIndex || 0);
    } else {
      console.log('servicesSync: deferring init for wrap index', $('.tab-services').index($wrap));
    }

    // Ensure we update slidesAll on refresh
    function refreshSlides() {
      $slidesAll = $wrap.find('.swiper-slide');
    }

    // Bind slideChange — event context "this" is the swiper instance that fired,
    // but we only toggle DOM for wraps that are active and own the introMap.
    try { swiperInst.off && swiperInst.off('slideChange.servicesSync'); } catch(e) {}
    swiperInst.on && swiperInst.on('slideChange', function () {
      refreshSlides();
      // Always use this.realIndex (the instance's current index)
      setVisibleByRealIndex(this.realIndex);
    });

    // Click on select-card inside this wrap — force mapping
    $wrap.off('.servicesSync').on('click.servicesSync', SERVICE_BOX_SEL, function (e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (typeof e.stopImmediatePropagation === 'function') e.stopImmediatePropagation();

      const $slide = $(this).closest('.swiper-slide');
      let idx = null;
      if ($slide && $slide.length) {
        const attr = $slide.attr('data-swiper-slide-index');
        idx = (typeof attr !== 'undefined') ? Number(attr) : $slide.index();
      }
      if (idx === null || Number.isNaN(idx)) idx = swiperInst.realIndex;
      // toggle only for this wrap
      setVisibleByRealIndex(idx);
    });

    const api = {
      refresh() {
        try { swiperInst.update && swiperInst.update(); } catch (err) {}
        refreshSlides();

        // If wrap active, ensure reset to 0 and show correct intro
        if (isWrapActive($wrap)) {
          try { if (swiperInst.realIndex && swiperInst.realIndex !== 0) swiperInst.slideTo(0, 0); } catch (e) {}
          setVisibleByRealIndex(swiperInst.realIndex || 0);
        } else {
          console.log('servicesSync: refresh skipped for inactive wrap index', $('.tab-services').index($wrap));
        }
      },
      destroy() {
        $wrap.off('.servicesSync');
        try { swiperInst.off && swiperInst.off('slideChange'); } catch (e) {}
        $wrap.removeData('servicesSync');
      },
      _introMap: introMap // exposed for debug if needed
    };

    $wrap.data('servicesSync', api);
    return api;
  }

  // ---------- deferred init wiring (same pattern as before) ----------
  function attachInitOnActivation($wrap) {
    const $tabContainer = $wrap.closest('.e-n-tabs, .elementor-widget-n-tabs, .elementor-tabs, .elementor-widget');
    if (!$tabContainer || !$tabContainer.length) {
      const $tabContent = $wrap.closest('.e-n-tab-content, .elementor-tab-content, .tab-pane, .tab-content');
      if ($tabContent && $tabContent.length) {
        const obs = new MutationObserver(function (mutations, observer) {
          for (const m of mutations) {
            if (m.type === 'attributes' && m.attributeName === 'class') {

                tryInitForWrap($wrap);
                observer.disconnect();
                return;
              }

        obs.observe($tabContent.get(0), { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class', 'style', 'aria-hidden'] });
      }
      return;
    }

    const observer = new MutationObserver(function (mutations, obs) {
      for (const m of mutations) {
        if (m.type === 'attributes' && (m.attributeName === 'class' || m.attributeName === 'aria-selected')) {
          const $activeContent = $tabContainer.find('.e-n-tab-content.e-active, .elementor-tab-content.active, .tab-pane.active').first();
          if ($activeContent && $activeContent.length && $activeContent.find(CAROUSEL_WRAPPER).filter(function(){ return $(this).is($wrap); }).length) {
            tryInitForWrap($wrap);
            obs.disconnect();
            return;
          }
          const $selTitle = $tabContainer.find('.e-n-tab-title[aria-selected="true"], .elementor-tab-title[aria-selected="true"]');
          if ($selTitle && $selTitle.length) {
            const contentId = $selTitle.attr('aria-controls');
            if (contentId) {
              const $content = $('#' + contentId);
              if ($content.length && $content.find(CAROUSEL_WRAPPER).filter(function(){ return $(this).is($wrap); }).length) {
                tryInitForWrap($wrap);
                obs.disconnect();
                return;
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    });

    observer.observe($tabContainer.get(0), { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class', 'aria-selected'], subtree: true });
    $tabContainer.off('click.servicesSyncInit').on('click.servicesSyncInit', '.e-n-tab-title, .elementor-tab-title', function () {
      setTimeout(function () { tryInitForWrap($wrap); }, 60);
    });
  }

  // ---------- init helpers ----------
  function tryInitForWrap($wrap, attempts = 0) {
    if (!$wrap.length) return;
    // if in a tab content and hidden, defer
    if (!$wrap.is(':visible') && $wrap.closest('.e-n-tab-content, .elementor-tab-content, .tab-pane, .tab-content').length) {
      attachInitOnActivation($wrap);
      return;
    }

    const api = createServicesSync($wrap);
    if (!api && attempts < MAX_RETRIES) {
      setTimeout(function () { tryInitForWrap($wrap, attempts + 1); }, RETRY_DELAY);
    } else if (api) {
      setTimeout(function () { try { api.refresh && api.refresh(); } catch (e) {} }, 120);
    } else {
      console.warn('servicesSync: init failed for wrap after retries', $wrap.get(0));
    }
  }

  function initServicesSync(scope) {
    const $scope = scope ? $(scope) : $(document);
    const $wraps = $scope.find(CAROUSEL_WRAPPER);
    if (!$wraps.length && !$scope.is(CAROUSEL_WRAPPER)) return;
    const $all = $wraps.add($scope.filter(CAROUSEL_WRAPPER));
    $all.each(function () { tryInitForWrap($(this)); });
  }

  function refreshSyncInContent($content, tabIndex) {
    setTimeout(function () {
      let $wraps = $content.find(CAROUSEL_WRAPPER);

          tryInitForWrap($w);
          setTimeout(function () { api = $w.data('servicesSync'); if (api && api.refresh) api.refresh(); }, 300);
        } else {
          api.refresh();
          setTimeout(function () { api.refresh && api.refresh(); }, 300);
        }
      });
    }, 50);
  }

  // ---------- tab click & observer wiring ----------
  $(document).on('click', '.e-n-tab-title, .elementor-tab-title', function () {
    const $tabButton = $(this);
    const tabIndex = parseInt($tabButton.attr('data-tab-index'));
    const contentId = $tabButton.attr('aria-controls');
    const $tabsWidget = $tabButton.closest('.e-n-tabs, .elementor-widget-n-tabs, .elementor-tabs');

      setTimeout(function () {
        let $activeContent = null;
        if (contentId) $activeContent = $('#' + contentId);
        if (!$activeContent || !$activeContent.length) $activeContent = $tabsWidget.find('.e-n-tab-content[data-tab-index="' + tabIndex + '"]');
        if (!$activeContent || !$activeContent.length) $activeContent = $tabsWidget.find('.e-n-tab-content.e-active, .elementor-tab-content.active, .tab-pane.active');

      setTimeout(function () {
        const $activeContent = $tabsWidget.find('.e-n-tab-content.e-active, .elementor-tab-content.active, .tab-pane.active');

      }, 350);
    }
  });

  const nestedTabsObserver = new MutationObserver(function (mutationsList) {
    for (const mutation of mutationsList) {
      if (mutation.type === 'attributes' && mutation.attributeName === 'class') {
        const $target = $(mutation.target);
        if ($target.hasClass('e-n-tab-content') && $target.hasClass('e-active')) {
          const $widget = $target.closest('.e-n-tabs, .elementor-widget-n-tabs');
          const $activeButton = $widget.find('.e-n-tab-title[aria-selected="true"]');
          const tabIndex = parseInt($activeButton.attr('data-tab-index'));
          setTimeout(function () { refreshSyncInContent($target, tabIndex); }, 100);
        }
      }
      if (mutation.type === 'attributes' && mutation.attributeName === 'aria-selected') {
        const $t = $(mutation.target);

          if (contentId) {

            }, 100);
          }

      }

  });

    nestedTabWidgets.forEach(function (widget) {
